title: Cosmobox Level3 S4 campaign manifest (v1)
description: Machine-readable transcription of the Level3 S4 first-campaign scientific contract (docs/levels/level3/s4-first-campaign-preregistration.md, frozen at commit 1c1d71f07dd6a7399b3965b2bb0acfa5c665991e). Fixes exactly the three new (geometry, S=4) cases, the reference-Hamiltonian/full-spectrum requirement, the primary/control metric split, and pins the frozen Level2 reference campaign identity that supplies the S=2/S=3 comparison data -- no scientific degree of freedom beyond what is already frozen.

frozen_preregistration_commit.description: The exact commit that froze docs/levels/level3/s4-first-campaign-preregistration.md (L3_S4_SCIENTIFIC_PREREGISTRATION = FROZEN).

cases.description: Exactly the three new Level3 S4 cases, geometry-major order -- never S=2/S=3 (those come from the frozen Level2 reference), never S=5.

physical_parameters.description: Documentary only -- not consumed by execution; the enforced values live in cosmobox.level2.execution's own frozen constants, reused unchanged by cosmobox.level3.execution.run_case.

numerical_guard_reference.description: The frozen L2-C1 numerical zero-resolution guards, reused unchanged for the S3<->S4 taxonomy.

level2_reference.description: The frozen Level2 campaign identity Level3 pins as its exclusive S=2/S=3 source -- never a caller-configurable value.

expected_s4_dimensions.description: Hilbert-space dimensions established by the L3-C capability preflight -- reference data, cross-checked by the campaign's gates against the real run_case(...).dimension.

validated_dense_capability.description: Must equal cosmobox.level3.execution.LEVEL3_VALIDATED_DENSE_DIMENSION_LIMIT (L3-E) -- an operational capacity limit, never a physical or convergence threshold.

forbidden_extensions.description: Documentary marker only -- the real enforcement is in code (planning.py's exact 3-case set, cosmobox.level0.encoding/cosmobox.level3.execution's own guards), never solely in this JSON field.
